messages:
maria: kicking off plan to add nullable `profile_v2` column + async backfill in the 45m maintenance slot at 12:15 UTC. using a staged rename swap for final cutover, expect ~90s exclusive window. :spiral_calendar:
jonathan: quick Q - are we doing shadow-table writes or additive-only? which clients need bumping?
maria: additive-only backfill. service clients should be pinned to 2.15.0 which knows about the new column; older clients will ignore it. we'll pin launcher during the rollout.
rachel: I'll update release notes: "users: add profile_v2 (nullable) + backfill; 90s swap downtime; feature-flagged rollout". include runbook link.
samir: oncall here - I'll own replica lag/watch and can abort if lag > 10s. what's the backfill parallelism?
maria: backfill workers=4, batch=10k, prefetch=6. if p95 CPU > 70% or memory > 75% we throttle to 2 workers.
deploybot: preflight OK: migration lint passed, estimated rows 22M, table size ~36M. holdpoint scheduled at 5000012360 by maria.
ops-runbook-bot: runbook created: https://runbooks.internal/backfills/profile-v2. monitors: db_lock_rate, read_p95, backfill_rows_per_min. alerts configured.
jonathan: who can flip the abort? list approvers please.
maria: approvers: samir (ops-oncall), leo (db-admin), rachel (product). any approver can trigger abort.
samir: adding alert: if db_lock_rate > 0.5% for 2m -> pager and mark this thread.
leo: note: rename swap will acquire an exclusive schema lock for ~70-120s on primary. traffic must be drained; coordinate with release gate.
rachel: we'll pin clients to 2.15.0 via deploybot release group, hold older runtimes at 2.14.x.
deploybot: canary started - routing 3% traffic to new write path (ff.profile_v2=true) at 5000012375. logs: "canary_slots=3"
maria: canary backfill throughput ~8k rows/min. no lock events so far.
jonathan: paste abort steps here so they're handy.
maria: abort steps:
```
# stop backfill workers
kubectl -n prod scale deployment user-profile-backfill --replicas=0
# flip feature flag off
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/migrations -d '{"profile_v2":false}'
# if rename partially applied: run rollback helper
psql -c "SELECT perform_safe_rename('users_profile_v2_swap_rollback');"
```
leo: perform_safe_rename will refuse to run if >2 long-running sessions reference the table. safeguards in place.
ops-runbook-bot: canary metrics at 5000012388: read_p95 +5% vs baseline, db_lock_rate 0.08%, no pager.
samir: still watching - replica lag 0s. backfill progress 28% on canary subset.
maria: gating criteria to go to 50%: 15m stable canary (read_p95 within +10%), db_lock_rate <0.2%, backfill progress >60%.
rachel: I'll draft the changelog entry and attach the rollback steps + runbook.
deploybot: holdpoint released at 5000012408 by maria. proceeding to ramp to 50%.
